title: kubecon-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for KubeCon US 2026 logistics / expenses / vendor contacts. Mostly notes-to-self and TODOs.

Flights / hotels
- Flight: SFO -> LAS, United UA2135, depart 2026-03-09 06:10, arrive 08:00. Booking ref: X9Z4PL. Checked bag (1) paid. Need to submit baggage receipt if reimbursing.
- Return: LAS -> SFO, 2026-03-12 18:45 UA2201.
- Hotel: Venetian Resort (group rate through Redwood), confirmation 987654321. Check-in 15:00 on 3/9, check-out 3/12. Keep folio for receipts (room + tax + incidentals).

Booth / shipping
- Booth shipper: Freeman (primary contact: Maria Lopez, maria.lopez@freeman.com, +1-702-555-0123).
  - Deadline for material arrival: 2026-03-06 (warehouse cutoff).
  - On-site contact: Marcus (Freeman) booth setup crew, cell +1-702-555-0456.
- Booth items to ship: 2 racks, demo laptop, 1 rolling banner, swag (stickers, shirts size M/L/XL). 
- Action: confirm final weight and submit shipping label by 2026-03-01. TODO: ask ops team for pallet dimensions.

On-site schedule / staffing
- Tuesday 3/9: Setup 10:00-16:00 (Alex, Jamie, Jordan).
- Wed-Fri 3/10-3/12: booth coverage shifts 09:30-13:30 / 13:30-17:30. Need overlap for demos.
- Evening meetup: 3/10 19:00 at The Dorsey (RSVP for 25). Catering + expense guidelines below.

Demos / demo hardware
- Demo machine: ThinkPad X1 (belongs to eng team). Local build of demo apps v1.3.2. Ensure Docker image pre-pulled and offline assets on SSD.
- Test network: wifi is flaky; bring own 4G hotspot (Verizon MiFi). SIM: company eSIM on device. Check APN setup.

Expense reminders (finance policy highlights)
- Per diem for meals: $75/day for conference days unless submitting actual receipts.
- Transportation: rideshare receipts OK; include start/end times and attendees if reimbursing group ride.
- Alcohol: allowed but must be reasonable and itemized; include context (client entertaining, team dinner).
- Swag purchases: submit receipts AND pre-approval email for >$500 spend.
- Shipping costs for booth: pre-approved under events budget; tag cost to project code: ENG-EVT-2026-KC.
- Receipt policy: attach PDFs/photos of receipts to Concur within 30 days. Name expenses with prefix KUBECON-2026 for easy review.

Vendor contacts (quick list)
- Freeman (booth): Maria Lopez, maria.lopez@freeman.com, +1-702-555-0123.
- A/V support: TechFX (contact: Samuel Ortiz, sam.ortiz@techfx.com, +1-312-555-0199).
- Catering (meetup): BiteRight Catering (contact: orders@biteright.com, acct mgr: Laura Chen, +1-415-555-0330).
- Shipping (company ops backup): FedEx acct rep: Greg Palmer, greg.palmer@fedex.com, +1-800-555-0777.

Pre-event checklist (actionable)
- [ ] Confirm final headcount for meetup (deadline 2026-03-01) (Jamie).
- [ ] Finalize swag quantities and sizes; get quote and PO from procurement (Jordan).
- [ ] Submit booth shipping label & manifest to Freeman (Alex).
- [ ] Pre-pull demo docker images and validate on laptop (Alex).
- [ ] Create shared Slack channel #kubecon-2026 for ops + volunteers (Samantha).
- [ ] Expense pre-approval: submit any >$500 items to finance (All).

During-event notes / shortcuts
- Expense tagging: always prefix with KUBECON-2026 then category (TRAVEL / MEALS / SWAG / SHIPPING).
- Receipts: photo immediately on phone; upload to Concur at end of day.
- Emergency: SRE pager on-call phone (ops lead) +1-650-555-0900.

Open questions / To confirm
- Do we have access to the exhibitor storage on-site or need to rent additional storage? (Ask Freeman contact).
- Can procurement expedite PO for swag if vendor needs 2-week lead? Procurement lead: Priya Nair.
- Who from leadership will join the meetup? Need headcount for alcohol + reserved space.

Notes to self
- Keep all shipping receipts consolidated under one expense item to simplify finance review.
- If booth needs emergency power adapters, buy locally (Target/BestBuy near Venetian).
- Remember to collect business cards and add to CRM within 48 hours.

Useful links / refs (for quick access)
- KubeCon exhibitor portal: https://events.kubernetes.io/kubecon-2026/exhibitor-login
- Redwood events budget doc (Confluence): CONFLUENCE:KubeCon-2026-Booth-Plan

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into formal events brief and share with ops + finance by 2026-03-05.
